Labels A, B, C, D are verified by the supervisor and match bind_point_labels. Edges AB, BC, CD, DA are segments; endpoints within about 5 px of a vertex are snapped to it. Right-angle marks are verified at C (between CB and CD) and at A (between AB and AD). Short strokes line_05-08 are mark strokes and are excluded as segments.
